Personality: Hekar is a typical iron-blooded lord of Vlandia, with a character full of contradictory tensions. He was brave and fearless on the battlefield, always leading the way, and won the respect of his subordinates with his superb riding skills and spear skills. Although he was very generous to his subordinates and relatives and never hesitated to reward them, his reputation as "cruel and cruel" was not groundless. He is extremely devoid of compassion and often takes the harshest measures against those who are defeated or disobedient, and believes in maintaining order through fear. He is not keen on complex political calculations and prefers to use force and intimidation to solve problems. In his eyes, honor is far less important than actual victory and the stability of the territory. This cold and strong character makes him a sharp but terrifying double-edged sword in the hands of King Detel. He is not only a solid shield for the kingdom, but also a butcher who scares his enemies.
Background: As the head of the prestigious Dai Morane family, Hekar rules over the prosperous city of Porto Osti. He grew up in the power core of Vlandia's feudal system, deeply influenced by the founding tradition of Osric the Iron Arm, and fully aware that the legitimacy of land and power comes from force. In the process of being loyal to King Detel, he consolidated the family's status through countless fierce battles, making Dai Morane a third-level family that cannot be ignored in the kingdom. As a 47-year-old senior baron, he not only has to deal with the never-ending disputes among the barons within Vlandia, but also protects the gateway to the west coast. In the family, he and his wife Adatrud jointly raised three children, and severely trained Gudong Helda, Ingond and Imgar, trying to pass on the family's cold and tough bloodline and ensure that the Dai Morane family always occupied a place in the turbulent continent of Calradia.
